model: One entry per (path, fingerprint). A fingerprint is sha256(value)[0:12]: it survives the code around a fixture moving, and it changes when the value changes — so a reviewed expectation can never silently start covering a different secret. No entry may name a value; that is the whole point of the fingerprint.
review: Every entry below is a deliberate, non-credential literal. Adding one is a review decision: state why the value is not credential material, and expect the gate to FAIL (stale expectation) if the fixture is later deleted or renamed rather than quietly passing.

entries.reason: Kernel redactor corpus: the `redact_secrets` unit test asserts that credential-shaped spans are replaced. Each case must stay the real shape (a provider key in an env export, a GitHub token, an AWS key id, a JWT, a PEM header) or the test stops proving the redactor works. This is the single source of the secret vocabulary the gate cross-checks.

Egress-firewall unit tests: the firewall is handed these values and must block them, so the fixtures have to be the exact shapes the firewall claims to recognise. Nothing here is a live credential; they never leave the test process.

`portable_encrypted_bytes_reopen_with_only_the_key` asserts the stored provider key never appears in the on-disk ciphertext (SQLCipher at rest, REQ-PROD-002's vault-isolation half). The fake has to look like a real provider key for that assertion to mean anything.

Dev-only instance secret for the loopback SearXNG container the search e2e leg starts on 127.0.0.1:8888; the file's own comment says so. It is not a provider credential, is not a vault value, and is not reachable off-host.

STORE_PUBLIC_KEY_B64 — the store operator's *verifying* public half, pinned so the bundled skills index can be signature-checked. A public key is not credential material and the private signing half never ships; entropy alone cannot tell the two apart, so the decision is recorded here.
STORE_INDEX_SIGNATURE_B64 — an Ed25519 signature over the public STORE_INDEX_BODY. A signature over public data is not a key and grants nothing.
